-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.watcher__send` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem mvcc.keptPairs_all (fs : List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (es : List Loc) (evm : List mvcc.EvM) (m :
    Nat) (hl : es.length = evm.length) (hm : es.length ≤ m) : mvcc.keptPairs fs es evm m =
    List.filter (fun x => fs.all fun p => !p x.snd) (es.zip evm)

def mvcc.keptPairs (fs : List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (es : List Loc) (evm : List mvcc.EvM) (m : Nat) :
    List (Loc × mvcc.EvM) :=
  List.filter (fun x => fs.all fun p => !p x.snd) (List.take m (es.zip evm))

theorem mvcc.keptPairs_snd (fs : List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (es : List Loc) (evm : List mvcc.EvM) (hl :
    es.length = evm.length) : List.map Prod.snd (List.filter (fun x => fs.all fun p => !p x.snd)
    (es.zip evm)) = mvcc.filtered fs evm

theorem mvcc.keptPairs_succ (fs : List (mvcc.EvM → Bool)) (es : List Loc) (evm : List mvcc.EvM) (m :
    Nat) (e : Loc) (ev : mvcc.EvM) (he : es[m]? = some e) (hev : evm[m]? = some ev) : mvcc.keptPairs
    fs es evm (m + 1) = mvcc.keptPairs fs es evm m ++ if (fs.all fun p => !p ev) = true then [(e,
    ev)] else []
